content: VulkanSceneGraph (vsg-dev/VulkanSceneGraph) is MIT licensed (vulkan.h exception is Apache-2.0). Actively maintained -- latest release v1.1.13 (Dec 30, 2025). Ships a first-class 'vsgheadless' example rendering to a VkFramebuffer and copying out to disk with no windowing, confirming genuine headless support. However it is a full scene-graph library (its own ref_ptr/Visitor/node-graph object model, Viewer/CommandGraph abstractions) -- a much larger conceptual surface than needed for direct schema-to-pipeline construction of single render passes.
